verdict: No direct Train Ticket/S0 answer hardcoding found in inspected inference paths; universality is not established and independent counterexamples reproduce transfer failures.

counterexamples.observed: Petclinic GET, PUT and DELETE /api/pets/12 each match getPet, updatePet and deletePet. The method option on RequestMapping is discarded.
List all pets and Show all pets choose PetTypeRestController.getAllPetTypes instead of PetRestController.getPets. Natural identifier wording also leaves petId unknown.
A 65-row findAll result is silently reduced to 64. The wrong small() branch is confirmed with complete_in_supported_model and no unresolved diagnostics. A 64-row control is correct.
Renaming a Memo field text to body erases the typed response and loses memoId on the next step. The text control resolves the ID.

scope_limits: Counterexamples disprove unrestricted transfer but do not measure aggregate accuracy on other repositories.
